changes: Create Bounty no longer uses CPU and memory on every frame while open, which made addon memory climb quickly. Long sessions also no longer build up battleground, Nearby and bounty alert records.
Bounty pages no longer pin the bounty board in place or draw a second shadow: drag a page's header to move the board.
Players with different addon languages who blacklist each other no longer send Reputation auto-replies back and forth endlessly. Replies always start with the English [Highground Reputation] prefix.
All ten translations were reviewed again against English. Battleground timer tags are translated, and battleground and spell names come from your game client.
